scripts.dev:electron: bun run transpile:electron && cross-env NODE_ENV=development npx --yes electron .
scripts.transpile:preload: bunx tsc src/electron/preload.ts --outDir dist-electron --module nodenext --target esnext --skipLibCheck
scripts.dist:mac: bun run transpile:electron && bun run build && bunx electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:win: bun run transpile:electron && bun run build && bunx electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:linux: bun run transpile:electron && bun run build && bunx electron-builder --linux --x64
